Test Case Title: Access and edit all form types
Test Description: From Form Builder select My Profile then each Submission and Review form for every stage make a small edit and verify each form is editable and changes remain on that form
Preconditions:
1. Admin is logged in
2. User is on Form Builder page
3. At least 2 stages exist
Test Steps:
1. Open Form Builder
2. Select My Profile in sidebar
3. Make a small change (e.g., add heading or rename a field)
4. Select each Submission form for every stage and make a small change
5. Select each Review form for every stage and make a small change
Expected Result:
1. My Profile form can be selected and edited
2. Submission forms for all stages can be selected and edited
3. Review forms for all stages can be selected and edited

Test Case Title: All required component types are available
Test Description: Open Form Options and verify required Static Elements and Form Elements are listed
Preconditions:
1. Admin is on Form Builder
2. Any form is selected
Test Steps:
1. Open Form Options panel
2. Verify Static Elements list
3. Verify Form Elements list
Expected Result:
1. Static Elements include Heading, Content, Divider, Page break
2. Form Elements include Text, Text Area, Checkbox, Radio, Drop-down, Auto suggest, Multi-Select, Date/time, Country, File upload, Image upload

Test Case Title: Drag and drop component placement
Test Description: Drag any component from Form Options to the canvas and verify it appears at the drop position and is editable
Preconditions:
1. Admin is on Form Builder
2. Form Options panel is visible
Test Steps:
1. Select any component (e.g., Text)
2. Drag the component onto the form canvas
3. Drop the component
Expected Result:
1. Component appears in the form layout at the drop position
2. Component is selectable for editing

Test Case Title: Custom fields data is reported
Test Description: Add a custom field to My Profile Submission and Review forms then populate as Submitter Reviewer and Committee and verify data shows in corresponding sections and reporting
Preconditions:
1. Admin can edit forms
2. Submitter/Reviewer/Committee accounts exist
Test Steps:
1. Add a custom field to My Profile form and save
2. Add a custom field to a Submission form and save
3. Add a custom field to a Review form and save
4. As Submitter, populate custom fields and submit
5. As Reviewer/Committee, populate custom fields and submit review
6. View corresponding sections and reports
Expected Result:
1. Custom field data appears in the correct My Profile/Submission/Review sections
2. Custom field data is available in reporting or exports for each role

Test Case Title: Configure visibility rules with all/any conditions
Test Description: Open visibility rules and verify All or Any conditions can be used with system and custom fields and operators match each field type
Preconditions:
1. Admin is editing a form
2. At least one system field and one custom field exist
Test Steps:
1. Open visibility rules for a field
2. Choose All conditions must be met
3. Add a condition using a system field
4. Add a condition using a custom field
5. Switch to Any conditions must be met
6. Verify operator options for different field types (text, date, choice)
Expected Result:
1. Rule builder supports both All and Any conditions
2. Conditions can use system and custom fields
3. Operator list matches field type (e.g., date has before/after, text has contains)

Test Case Title: Save success and error handling
Test Description: Click Save and verify button disables during save success shows message and hides button and failure shows error and re enables button
Preconditions:
1. Admin is in Build Mode
2. Form has changes
Test Steps:
1. Click Save
2. Observe button state during save
3. Confirm success message and Save button disappears
4. Simulate save failure (e.g., network error) and click Save again
Expected Result:
1. Save button disables while saving
2. On success, success message appears and Save button disappears
3. On failure, error message appears and Save button re-enables

Test Case Title: Manage multiple forms independently
Test Description: Edit two different forms and verify changes are isolated and each form requires its own save
Preconditions:
1. At least two forms exist
2. Admin is in Build Mode
Test Steps:
1. Edit Form A and make a change without saving
2. Switch to Form B and make a different change
3. Save Form B only
4. Return to Form A
Expected Result:
1. Form B changes are saved without affecting Form A
2. Form A still shows its own unsaved changes
3. Each form requires its own save action
